_doc: WP-Q1 named light presets (coordinator/Fable 2026-11-05, after the creator's 'historical, epic, rich world' note): Blender Studio's Wing It! rule as data, shared by WP-Q1 (shading), WP-Q4 (the character benchmark) and WP-Q8 (the world kits). Only the key SUN casts a shadow; two colourable rims (rim_a, rim_b) light the cast only (light linking), shadowless, specular <= 0.3; an optional shadowless fill; one world tint per sequence (the ambient light's colour and strength; camera rays still see the look's sky). Rim aims are relative to the camera (elevation, azimuth offset from straight behind the subject); the key's azimuth is world-fixed so a set keeps its light across shots. Sun strength 1 = a white surface facing it shows 1.0. Every number is HYP until the creator judges the clips; colours are RGB multipliers, never palette hex.

golden_hour.feel: low warm sun, a hot orange rim on one side and a cool sky rim on the other, warm-blue air

noon_epic.feel: high bright sun for battle and establishing shots, a warm rim, clear blue sky air

overcast_day.feel: soft cool daylight, gentle rims, grey-blue air: rain, mourning, sieges

interior_hearth.feel: a hall by firelight: warm side key, a fire-orange rim and a cold window rim, deep warm air

night_moon.feel: cool moonlight key, a warm torch rim, deep blue air
